# The format of PROJ's former `epsg` init file, as PROJ's get_init_string reads it, and as the
# host table of adapter-epsg and the init files of the mapfile frontend are read (ADR-0023). Each
# `# expect` line states what both readers make of a code; both crates' tests run this file.
# expect 1 = +proj=longlat +ellps=GRS80 +no_defs
<1> +proj=longlat
    +ellps=GRS80
    +no_defs <>
# expect 2 = +proj=merc +lon_0=0
<2> +proj=merc # a comment inside a definition
    +lon_0=0 <>
# The first definition of a code holds.
<1> +proj=tmerc <>
# expect 3 refused grid file
<3> +proj=longlat +nadgrids=ntv1_can.dat <>
# expect 4 refused init=
<4> +init=epsg:1 <>
# The first definition holds even when it is empty.
# expect 5 refused no definition
<5> <>
<5> +proj=longlat <>
